seo.description: A small file-based CMS built with Nuxt 4, Nuxt UI, and useFetch.

blocks.title: Learn Nuxt 4 the practical way
blocks.description: A frontend-only site where every page reads its content through useFetch, and a catch-all route resolves whatever URL you throw at it.

items.title: useFetch everywhere
items.description: Every page reads data through useFetch against a small Nitro API, no direct storage access from components.

items.title: Catch-all routing
items.description: [...slug].vue resolves any CMS page on the fly and falls through to a real 404 for the rest.

items.title: Two content sources, one contract
items.description: Site pages are local JSON files; articles come from DummyJSON, a public API. Both get validated with zod before a component ever sees them.
